build_system: pnpm + turbo, no compilation step for internal packages (raw .ts exports via main/exports field)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm --filter @oxagen/storage test:unit (vitest run). 2. Run pnpm --filter @oxagen/storage typecheck (tsc --noEmit). 3. Run pnpm --filter @oxagen/storage test:coverage to verify coverage thresholds still pass.
environment_constraints: Network likely open. No Docker needed for this package (pure TS library). BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN env var is already optional in base schema. requireEnv from @oxagen/config/env validates a subset of env vars.
contribution_requirements: Push directly to main after pnpm gate. New code requires new tests. Coverage thresholds must stay at or above current levels (lines:78, branches:78, functions:68, statements:78). Zero ESLint warnings.
key_patterns: 1. StorageAdapter interface in types.ts with get/put/delete methods. 2. createVercelBlobAdapter(token) returns StorageAdapter. 3. storage() singleton in client.ts memoizes a single adapter instance, uses requireEnv to get BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN. 4. StorageNotFoundError class in vercel-blob.ts. 5. Consumers import from '@oxagen/storage' (never @vercel/blob directly). 6. Internal docs go in docs/guides/ or docs/architecture/. 7. Tests use vi.mock() with vi.hoisted() for factory mocks, vi.resetModules() for singleton reset.
directory_structure: packages/storage/src/ contains: index.ts (barrel), types.ts (StorageAdapter interface), vercel-blob.ts (Vercel Blob driver), client.ts (singleton factory), assets.ts (validation utils), ingest.ts (image ingestion), logger.ts (pino logger). Tests colocated as *.test.ts. docs/guides/ has internal dev docs.
